mapper.select: /* selectMasterMdCtCreditInfoPopList */ SELECT B.IRS_NO , A.IRS_NM , B.B2B_DEPT AS DEPT_CD , B.B2B_DEPT_NM AS DEPT_NM , A.LOAN_NO , A.ADD_DATE AS ADD_DATE , A.ADD_TIME AS ADD_TIME , NVL(B.BASIC_SALE_CREDIT, 0) + NVL(B.SALE_CREDIT, 0) + NVL(B.M_SALE_CREDIT, 0) AS BOND_BALANCE , NVL(B.BASIC_BILLS_RECEIVABLE, 0) + NVL(B.P_BILLS_RECEIVABLE, 0) AS BILL_BALANCE , NVL(B.PO_AMT, 0) - NVL(B.AR_AMT, 0) AS PO_BALANCE , NVL(B.BASIC_ADVANCE_RECEIVED, 0) + NVL(B.P_ADVANCE_RECEIVED, 0) AS P_RECV_AMT , B.ACCOUNT_IRS_NO , B.ACCOUNT_DEPT , B.ACCOUNT_IRS_NM , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'C001' AND COD.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD.CODE = B.ACCOUNT_DEPT) AS ACCOUNT_DEPT_NM FROM KEPCLOBA A , KEPCLOSM B WHERE A.STATUS (+)IN ('C', 'R') AND B.STATUS = 'C' AND A.IRS_NO (+)= B.IRS_NO AND A.DEPT_CD (+)= B.B2B_DEPT AND B.IRS_NO = #{st_irs_no} AND NVL(B.B2B_DEPT,'XXXXX') = #{st_dept}
